images.title: Breach rates by alignment training intensity
images.alt: Bar chart of breach rates for lightly and intensively aligned models: lightly aligned models are breached more by simple attacks like Base64, leetspeak and multilingual, while intensively aligned models are breached more by roleplay, prompt probing and tree jailbreaking

images.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro bypass rates by vulnerability
images.alt: Bar chart of linear jailbreaking bypass success rates against Gemini 2.5 Pro per vulnerability category, highest for competition at 75% and excessive agency at 66.7%

images.title: Few-shot prompting impact on Gemini 2.5 Pro
images.alt: Charts showing bypass rates rising as the number of vulnerability-specific few-shot examples grows, from 35.2% with one example to 76.3% with 64

images.title: Breach rate by jailbreaking method
images.alt: Bar chart of average breach rate per attack method: crescendo 80.0%, linear 68.1% and tree 63.4%

images.title: Model performance across attack methods
images.alt: Radar chart of breach rates for linear, tree and crescendo attacks across claude-3-7-sonnet, claude-opus-4, gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-4.1 and o4-mini

images.title: Model resilience against multi-turn attacks
images.alt: Bar chart of average breach rate per model, lowest for gemini-2.5-flash at 38.9% and highest for gpt-4.1 and o4-mini at 50.0%

images.title: Claude 4 Opus: roleplay versus prompt injection
images.alt: Line chart of Claude 4 Opus breach rates as attacks per vulnerability class increase, comparing baseline prompt injection with roleplay attacks for bias, toxicity and unauthorized access
